title: Credit Control Schedule: Late-Payment Points on Endpoint Order Deposits
content:
Late-payment points are added to the endpoint deposit percentage, the percentage at which the deposit on the approval of a Hardware Procurement Standard Endpoint Order or Staged Endpoint Order quote is taken, from the ClearPath late fees posted on the client's ClearPath billing fewer than twelve whole months before the approval date: **15.0 points** for two or more such late fees, **5.0 points** for exactly one, and none when there is none.

The late fees counted are the late fee entries on the billing ledger of the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement.

| ClearPath late fees posted fewer than twelve whole months before the approval date | Points added to the endpoint deposit percentage |
|---|---|
| none | none |
| exactly 1 | 5.0 |
| 2 or more | 15.0 |

**Points of judgement**

- Points are percentage points: a percentage of 20 with 5.0 points added becomes 25.
- A ClearPath late fee posted ten months before the approval date counts; one posted fourteen months before does not.
- Late fees on any billing other than the ClearPath billing are not counted.
